name: chip
title: Chip
description: Side-on golf in the panel. Aim with the arrows, hold Space for the power, put spin on in the air: backspin bites, topspin runs on. One hole for now, The Needle, a par 4 with a pond, a cliff and an arch you can drive through.
author: pal

settings.label: Volume
settings.description: How loud the shots, the bounces and the wind are.

store.tagline: Side-on golf: aim, time the power, spin it in the air

actions.title: Aim
actions.description: Up raises the shot, down lowers it; hold Shift to move it finely.

actions.title: Face the other way
actions.description: Before the shot, the arrow toward the other side turns you round.

actions.title: Shoot
actions.description: Hold for the power, which rises and falls; let go to hit.

actions.title: Spin
actions.description: In the air, before it lands: back (the arrow away from where it flies) bites, forward runs on.

actions.title: Change the look
actions.description: Canyon, Alpine, Dusk or the drawn one; the choice is kept.

actions.title: Change the style
actions.description: Cartoon, Soft or Silhouette for the ground, the golfer, the ball and the flag, over any look but the drawn one; kept like the look.

features: Aim, hold Space and let go at the power you want: the meter lingers at the top and the bottom, so a full drive and a soft putt can both be repeated
Spin it in the air: backspin lifts the flight and bites on landing, topspin dips it and runs on
Every surface plays its own way: the fairway rolls, the rough grabs, sand stops the ball dead, the green rolls true, rock kicks it off
The Needle, a par 4: over the pond, up the cliff and onto the green behind a spire of rock, or through the arch at its foot from the tee
Four looks on L: a canyon at noon, the same canyon at dusk, an alpine morning (layered landscapes by PWL, CC0), and the drawn original; night in the dark theme

screenshots.caption: The tee in the canyon: the aim, the power meter, and the flag 84 m off over a pond and a cliff
Up and down aim the shot; hold space for power, and the arrows spin the ball in flight
L changes the look: the same canyon at dusk, or the alpine morning
